findings.title: Benefis Health System announces discontinuation of outpatient counseling, psychiatry and psychology in Great Falls
findings.exact_supporting_passage: Benefis says it will discontinue offering outpatient counseling, psychiatry and psychology services and instead work with partner organizations
findings.service_line: Outpatient counseling, psychiatry and psychology; associated restructuring of 20-bed inpatient rehabilitation facility and Northwest Clinic location
findings.access_consequences: Benefis has decided to discontinue its own outpatient counseling, psychiatry, and psychology services and direct patients to outside partners, including Center for Mental Health and Shodair Children's Hospital. The separately announced 20-bed West Campus inpatient rehabilitation facility will discontinue services, with swing-bed and transitional care offered as alternatives. Northwest Clinic services will consolidate on East Campus. These are stated service changes, not merely an ownership or financing story. Full loss of behavioral health care is NOT claimed; other levels of care were not announced closed.
findings.affected_population: Great Falls and surrounding Cascade County patients using outpatient mental-health treatment and 20-bed inpatient rehabilitation; total number affected not disclosed.
findings.evidence_notes: Newly recovered in this supplemental recall, not first announced within this hour. The reported restructuring begins December 19, 2026 and continues into 2027; the precise discontinuation date for each service is not specified, so effective_date is null. Local reporting quotes Benefis email to employees and media. Provider's existing service webpage still advertises outpatient offerings; should not be interpreted as proof the announced termination was withdrawn. Verify production deduplication before advancement.
